results.title: Fragmented
results.overview: From the shores of Malta, a pioneering journalist from Gaza, Qassem, contemplates his experiences as a political prisoner and his painful decision to leave his homeland.

results.title: If You Don't Like It, Look Away
results.overview: Every day, Joëlle meets her retired friends on Bain des Dames’s beachin Marseille. Like in an open-air theater, they laugh, talk about love, sex, aging bodies, and remake the world with the freedom of those who have nothing left to prove.

results.title: Sosok Ketiga: Lintrik
results.overview: After six months of marriage, Andin begins to notice many oddities in her marriage. From the beginning, Uncle Bagyo suspected the marriage was rushed, and together with Amara—Andin's younger sister who also inherited the mystical arts—he often noticed disturbing, odd signs.  Their suspicions were proven correct when it was revealed that Ario, Andin's husband, had been having a special relationship with Naura, a wealthy woman in their town who was trying to steal Ario completely from Andin using the Lintrik love spell, a dangerous mystical power that dragged Andin and her family into endless supernatural terror. What will happen to Andin and Ario's marriage going forward?

results.title: Lady Gaga: MAYHEM on the Beach
results.original_title: Todo Mundo no Rio com Lady Gaga
results.overview: The second edition of Todo Mundo no Rio, internationally known as MAYHEM on the Beach, marked a historic moment on Copacabana Beach. After thirteen years away from the country, Lady Gaga returned to Brazil with a free concert promoting her eighth studio album, MAYHEM (2025). With a record-breaking crowd of 2.5 million people, the show became the biggest performance of her career and cemented her as the female artist with the largest audience in history.

results.title: Beam Me Up, Sulu
results.overview: In 1985, Star Trek's George Takei joined a group of dedicated fans to make a student film deep in the California forest—only for the footage to mysteriously vanish. Nearly 40 years later, Beam Me Up, Sulu unearths this lost film, revealing not just a piece of fan history but a broader story of representation, resilience, and the ongoing fight for inclusion in media and society. The film was released as Yorktown: A Time to Heal (2022)

results.title: Door Prize
results.overview: Mars Brito, a trans bike courier, is killed by an SUV. Is he the victim of an accidental 'door prize', or is this murder? His case becomes a city-wide obsession, with hourly true crime updates and rewards for clues. While this murder mystery unfolds, a Toronto trans activist (also named Mars) works with his friends on an operatic memorial, creating arias for each of the 375 trans murders that were committed around the world that year. Door Prize weaves together documentary, drama, and opera scenes into a hybrid film that explores issues of media spectacle, solidarity violence, trans visibility, and anti-trans violence.

results.title: Seeker
results.overview: A new tenant seeking a fresh start faces an unseen threat, pushing her toward a sinister fate as the apartment's secrets are slowly revealed.

results.title: Stardom Dream Queendom 2025
results.overview: Dream Queendom 2025 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on December 29, 2025, at Ryōgoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, and headlined by Saya Kamitani (c) vs. Saori Anou for the World of Stardom Championship.

results.title: Second Sister
results.overview: High school student 'Ji-eun' was the victim of the crime, but distorted online posts and malicious comments made her into the perpetrator in the public eye, driving her to take her own life. Her sister 'So-eun' finds detective 'Jun-kyung' to uncover the truth behind her sister's unfair death, and he begins hunting down a suspect in cyberspace. As clues are revealed one by one, the case grows from a simple rumor into a complex web of truth involving anonymous accounts.

results.title: MAcrodosis
results.overview: Tino, a carefree young man, takes a hallucinogenic mushroom he accidentally found in his mother’s urn. However, his night takes an unexpected turn when his mother manifests herself, bringing along friends from Tino’s childhood. What begins as an ordinary evening turns into a surreal journey, filled with encounters with the bizarre, conversations with the beyond, and attempts to tie up loose ends.

results.title: Maxton Hall: Reunion
results.overview: Before class returns, the Maxton Hall cast reunites to reminisce about the filming of the series at iconic Marienburg castle and look forward to the Season 2 premiere.

results.title: Chris Distefano: It's Just Unfortunate
results.overview: Chris Distefano is trying to be the best father he can be but nowadays, words speak louder than actions—so Chris is acting with the right intentions, but not always the right moves.

results.title: Ghoul Squad
results.overview: An intrepid journalist shadows a group of ghost hunters as they conduct paranormal investigations at some of Britain's most haunted sites and buildings.

results.title: Die by Law
results.overview: Two SFPD detectives unveil a dark secret while investigating a car theft operation.

results.title: Wacker
results.overview: The 14 to 16-year-old players of FFC Wacker from Munich use the time before and after the matches for a personal conversation. The game of soccer brings together young people from different social and ethnic backgrounds.

results.title: Seed
results.overview: A psychological drama about Nnenna, who is consumed by the longing for a son after having daughters. She turns to a spiritualist’s ritual involving three sacred morning seeds. When her youngest child swallows the final seed, she spirals.

results.title: Final Act
results.overview: Detective Ellery Queen sets out to solve a puzzling case following the sudden death of a wealthy businessman.
